title: Jim Rider speech on devas, fairies and the veil thinning

tellings.quote: there's a speech that Jim Rider gives that's available online where he's talking about devas and fairies and jinn and he's talking about extrasensory perception and the veil thinning.

plain: Michels says that Jim Ryder, a figure tied to Lockheed Martin's space division, gave a speech that you can find online about devas (nature spirits of Hindu and Buddhist tradition), fairies and jinn (spirits of Islamic tradition). Michels says Ryder also talks about extrasensory perception and "the veil thinning" between our world and another. Michels tells this himself. If true, people inside a major defence company take the spirit world seriously.
